title: AKOS workflow frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block of workflows/*.md. schema_version 1 requires frontmatter to be present and requires schema_version itself; every other field stays optional so a future minimal workflow still validates. A file with no leading '---' block is now an error, not an informational skip — all 9 real workflows carry full frontmatter (id, description, agents, packs, profiles, status, maintainer) as of this version.

schema_version.description: Which version of this contract the file was authored against. An unknown value must fail explicitly, never fall back to the current schema.
